matches.prediction: Canterbury faces Northland in the Bunnings NPC. Canterbury’s potent attack has seen them score over 30 points on average recently. Northland has struggled defensively on the road. Back Canterbury to win this match decisively, given their superior pack weight and consistent set-piece dominance over the past month.

The Bulls return to Loftus Versfeld where altitude always plays a huge factor. Ulster must cope with a grueling travel schedule and recent minor injuries to key forwards. Expect the Bulls to win this URC clash by controlling possession and dominating the physical collisions from start to finish.

The Stormers are exceptionally tough to beat in Cape Town and boast a fully fit backline that has been carving through defenses. Scarlets have leaked tries out wide in their last three matches. Take the Stormers to secure a comfortable home victory with their potent attacking threats.

Glasgow Warriors travel to Italy with a strong recent record against Benetton. Benetton's discipline has been an issue, conceding an average of 14 penalties per game. Glasgow's superior kicking game and organized defense make them the smart selection to take the points in this fixture.

Leinster's depth is virtually unmatched in the URC, and their forward pack has been dominating the gain line efficiently. Cardiff comes off a physically draining encounter and faces several key absences due to international rest protocols. Leinster is the undeniable pick to win by a significant margin.
